create_series_from_coo: create a pandas Series with sparse values from a scipy sparse COO matrix
convert_series_to_dense: convert a pandas Series from sparse values to dense format
convert_series_to_coo: convert a pandas Series with MultiIndex to a scipy sparse COO matrix
